req.title: Redirect to arbitrary URL
req.statement: The system shall issue an HTTP 302 redirect to the URL given by the 'url' query parameter of /redirect-to.

doc.reasoning: The redirect_to() handler reads 'url' from query args, sets status_code=302 by default, and writes the exact URL string into the Location header. To maximise mutation kill rate I need to: (1) assert status_code == 302 exactly (catches constant mutations); (2) assert Location == the exact URL string (catches string-mutation and header-name mutations); (3) test with a custom 3xx status_code param at the boundary values 300, 399 and outside (299, 400) to cover the range-check `>= 300 and < 400`; (4) test missing 'url' param (negative path / KeyError); (5) test that a non-3xx status_code param is ignored and 302 is still returned (decision-table); (6) test a URL containing unicode/UTF-8 to cover the encode('utf-8') branch.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_basic_302_and_location
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: status 302 + Location set to url param
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_basic_302_and_location():
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=https://example.com')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == 'https://example.com'

test_redirect_to_basic_302_and_location()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_unicode_url_in_location
expected: Location header contains the unicode URL
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: source encodes url with utf-8; unicode chars must survive round-trip
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
try:
    from urllib.parse import quote
except ImportError:
    from urllib import quote
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_unicode_url_in_location():
    target = 'https://example.com/path?q=h\u00e9llo'
    encoded_target = quote(target, safe=':/?=&')
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + encoded_target)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    loc = r.headers['Location']
    assert loc is not None
    assert 'example.com' in loc

test_redirect_to_unicode_url_in_location()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_location_header_name_is_location
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: header name must be 'Location' (case-insensitive check + exact value)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_location_header_name_is_location():
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=https://target.example.org')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    # Verify the header key exists (case-insensitive) and value is exact
    loc = r.headers.get('Location')
    assert loc is not None
    assert loc == 'https://target.example.org'
    # Also confirm it is NOT pointing somewhere else
    assert loc != 'https://example.com'

test_redirect_to_location_header_name_is_location()
